prompt: Stage 3 is starting and you have 30 gold. Put the events of the stage in the order they happen, so you know when you will be asked to spend and when you can hold.

steps: Augment choice, then a fight against a player
Monster round: the monsters drop components or gold
Carousel: every player picks a champion carrying an item
The first fight of the stage, against a player
Two fights against players, back to back

explanation:
Every stage follows the same seven-round shape: 3-1 is a player fight, 3-2 is a player fight with an augment choice before it (augments come at 2-1, 3-2 and 4-2), 3-3 is another fight, 3-4 is the carousel, 3-5 and 3-6 are fights, and 3-7 is the monster round that drops loot. Once you know the shape you can plan the stage: the augment at 3-2 is where most players buy level 6, the carousel at 3-4 is a free component you can plan an item around, and the monster loot at 3-7 is the last item before stage 4.

The common confusion is the carousel and the augment: the carousel is every stage at round 4; the augment is only three times a game and not always at the same round. If you cannot place them, you cannot decide whether the gold in your pocket is needed this round or two rounds from now.
principle: Fight, augment fight, fight, carousel, fight, fight, monsters. Every stage, the same shape.
commonMistake: Not knowing whether the carousel or the monster round comes next, and spending the gold that would have been interest for both.
hint: Start from the fixed points: round 4 is always the carousel and round 7 is always monsters. Then place the augment round of stage 3.
